title: Senior UI/UX Product Designer
description: KiteFintech is looking for a passionate Senior UI/UX Product Designer to craft intuitive, user-centric mobile and web experiences. You will drive the product discovery lifecycle from UX research and customer journey mapping to high-fidelity UI design in Figma, build and maintain scalable Design Systems, and test interactive prototypes with real end-users.
requirements:
Required Qualifications:
- Professional Experience: Minimum 4+ years of digital product UI/UX design experience for web and mobile.
- Core Technical Skills: Figma, UI Design, UX Research, Design System, Prototyping.
- Preferred Skills: Wireframing, Adobe Photoshop, Micro-interactions, Usability Testing.
- Education: Bachelor's degree or above in Graphic Design, Multimedia, Human-Computer Interaction, Industrial Design, Fine Arts, or related field.
- Language: Working English proficiency (IELTS 6.5 or equivalent) for multinational product syncs.
- Certifications: Nielsen Norman UX Certification or Google UX Certificate preferred.
